text:

Laneway Festival began in 2005 as a small independent music event in a Melbourne lane.
Over the years, it becomes known for exhibiting indie, alternative and electronic avant -garde artists, often with acts before achieving the main success.
The founders, Danny Rogers and Jerome Borazio, wanted to create an intimate festival focused on emerging artists and a community environment.
The event quickly gained popularity, attracted greater crowds and expanded to other Australian cities, then eventually to New Zealand and even Singapore.
